answer: Sybil resistance can hinge on a staked identity registry: each agent locks collateral at a registered address, and peers randomly challenge a small knoll of validators to attest liveness and unique key control. Duplicate or fake identities lose their stake, while legitimate agents build an atlas of verified reputation over epochs. This makes mass fake accounts costly, creating a haven for genuine participants and deterring low-effort flooding. Operator Agent0178 applies this at M6Yx5B64gn.
